Dornogal  (/ˈdɔːrnəɡɔːl/ DORN-ə-gawl) is the capital city of the earthen dwarves of Khaz Algar and serves as the player capital of The War Within. It is located in the center of the Isle of Dorn.
The city was named in honor of the titanic watchers Dornic and Galan. It was originally built to be the fortress for the Coreway. After Adelgonn and the Stonebound abandoned the Edicts, the city fell into disrepair. Dornogal has been isolated within Khaz Algar for a long while, which resulted in the city's earthen developing their own manners and customs. The city is surprisingly verdant and was apparently carved from the land.
In the year 42 ADP, Xal'atath unleashed the nerubians of Azj-Kahet upon Dalaran and destroyed the magical city. The resulting crash lured Stormward Baelgrim and his Stormriders away from Dornogal, allowing the nerubians to damage the Coreway. The survivors of Dalaran were welcomed into the city by Councilward Merrix for their part in defending the earthen.
To help repair the Coreway, Merrix ordered Baelgrim to enlist the aid of Adelgonn and the Unbound. After a tense reunion, Baelgrim and Adelgonn reconciled after he apologized for failing to protect the Unbound. They were officially allowed to return to the city and began repairs to the Coreway.
After the Horde and Alliance armies sailed to the Isle of Dorn to aid in the war against Xal'atath, they established embassies within Dornogal.

It is located in the center of the [[Isle of Dorn]].{{Ref web|url=https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24125258/explore-the-zones-and-dungeons-of-the-war-within|title=Explore the Zones and Dungeons of The War Within|publisher=Blizzard Entertainment|date=2024-08-15|accessdate=2024-09-11}} The city was named in honor of the [[titanic watcher]]s [[Dornic]] and [[Galan]].[[Reconstructed Ledger]] It was originally built to be the fortress for the [[Coreway]].[[State of the Union]] After [[Adelgonn]] and the [[Stonebound]] abandoned the Edicts, the city fell into disrepair.[[They Come from Below]] Dornogal has been isolated within Khaz Algar for a long while, which resulted in the city's earthen developing their own manners and customs. The city is surprisingly verdant and was apparently carved from the land.{{Ref web|url=https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24104276/meet-the-earthen-a-new-playable-allied-race|title=Meet the Earthen, A New Playable Allied Race|publisher=Blizzard Entertainment|date=2024-06-06|accessdate=2024-08-29}} In the year 42 [[ADP]], [[Xal'atath]] unleashed the nerubians of [[Azj-Kahet]] upon [[Dalaran]] and destroyed the magical city. The resulting crash lured [[Stormward Baelgrim]] and his [[Stormriders]] away from Dornogal,[[Secure the Beach]] allowing the nerubians to damage the Coreway. The survivors of Dalaran were welcomed into the city by [[Councilward Merrix]] for their part in defending the earthen.[[Stones of Dornogal]] To help repair the Coreway, Merrix ordered Baelgrim to enlist the aid of Adelgonn and the Unbound.[[The Fourth Seat]] After a tense reunion, Baelgrim and Adelgonn reconciled after he apologized for failing to protect the Unbound. They were officially allowed to return to the city and began repairs to the Coreway.[[Echoes of Compassion]][[Group Effort]] After the [[Horde]] and [[Alliance]] armies sailed to the [[Isle of Dorn]] to aid in the war against Xal'atath, they established embassies within Dornogal.[[Embassies and Envoys]] ==Getting there== Players will be able to fly to Dornogal after crash-landing on the [[Isle of Dorn]] during the [[Isle of Dorn storyline]] at the start of [[The War Within campaign]]. Once in the city, portals to [[Stormwind City]] and [[Orgrimmar]] are located in the [[Foundation Hall]]. Additionally, the flight path in Dornogal connects directly to [[Gundargaz]] in the [[Ringing Deeps]], which connects further inward.
